audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart gave Brand 6 of 7 stages while Aurelion Sol wins 54.34% over 541 games, and phases[4..6].side disagreed with win[4..6] on three rows.
audit.why: Brand's edge is real levels 1-5 (Pillar of Flame 900 range, Sear stun on ablaze targets) but Aurelion Sol's stardust curve plus Falling Star flips the matchup from the first item onward, matching the win rate.
audit.corrected: Brand 1/2/3/4-5, Skill at 6, Aurelion Sol at first item and 2+ items — proposed as matched full+content pairs.

audit.why: Spikes are Brand at level 6 (Pyroclasm, 100/90/80s) and Aurelion Sol at Rod of Ages and again at full stardust (The Skies Descend). spikes[2].text named Stormsurge/Shadowflame while the item plan in report[8] is Rod of Ages first.
audit.corrected: Realigned spikes[2] to the Rod of Ages HP-pool spike that lets you hold the beam through Blaze burn.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing stated that Sear (Q) interrupts Breath of Light (Q) and Astral Flight (W) — both are flagged 'interruptible — any CC cancels it'.
audit.why: Sear only stuns when the target is ablaze, so players read it as safe when Blaze is not on them. The channel cancel is the decisive interaction: Brand's 8/7.5/7/6.5/6s Q ends your entire damage pattern.
audit.corrected: Stated in breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d — never start the channel with Sear up; the beam window is the 8 seconds after it is spent.

audit.why: Sear is 8s at rank 1 and Pyroclasm 100s at rank 1 — concrete windows beat 'read it like a minimap'.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[1].d.

audit.why: packet.suspectNames flagged 'Pillar of Flame' twice; the kit confirms Pillar of Flame is Brand's real W name.

edits.before: Pyroclasm at 6 is a genuine one-rotation burst threat you can't out-damage yet
edits.after: Falling Star answers his 100-second Pyroclasm — even stakes once your R is up

edits.before: Two items in you still lack the burst to flip a stationary poke mage outright
edits.after: Rod of Ages outlasts his burn and your E outranges his 900-range Pillar of Flame

edits.before: - Brand Sear (Stun): matchup-defining — Q only stuns when you are ablaze — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge that matters. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Astral Flight like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Sear is 8s at rank 1 and only stuns while Blaze is on you — but it interrupts Breath of Light and Astral Flight either way, so start the channel after it is spent. - Guard your W Astral Flight like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.

edits.before: Q only stuns when you are ablaze — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge that matters. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: Sear cancels Breath of Light even without the stun, so never open the channel with his Q up — once it is spent you get eight free seconds of beam.

edits.before: W-flyby: fly a lateral arc, drag Q across Brand for two seconds of burn + stacks, and land outside his answer range — repeat forever from one item.
edits.after: Falling Star stuns him out of the Pyroclasm cast — hold R for his commit, never for poke, and a 100-second ultimate on his side buys you the whole fight.

edits.before: Brand wins by landing Sear (Stun), denying your pattern, and renting you the lane at a range markup.
edits.after: Brand wins by stacking Blaze with Pillar, stunning you with Sear, then landing a full Pyroclasm rotation.

edits.before: Carry by scaling honestly — every stardust stack is permanent, and the 30-minute version of you wins fights your laning self cannot imagine.
edits.after: Carry by outranging him: your 1250-range R and 750 beam open fights his 900 Pillar cannot answer, so Blaze never reaches three stacks on you.

edits.before: That is Brand’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: Three Blaze stacks detonate in 2 seconds — greeding beam ticks feeds his stun setup.

edits.before: Liandry's/Luden's timers make his poke unavoidable through minions, but once you finish Stormsurge or Shadowflame your comet and Q collision damage starts trading back.
edits.after: Liandry's makes his Blaze burn unavoidable through minions, but Rod of Ages gives you the health pool to eat one Pillar of Flame and hold the beam on him through the burn.

notes: packet.suspectNames flagged 'Pillar of Flame' as a wrong name twice — both are false positives; the kit confirms the name. Left breakdown.feeding and ahead alone: both are semi-templated but already carry Brand-specific content and I had nothing verified to replace them with. spikes[0].text says Astral Flight starts are 'animation-locked' — not in Riot's text, left as-is and recorded as unverified.
